title: Coordinated cleanup of .tmp worktrees that hold a ui/node_modules junction to the master checkout
outcome: Every worktree under .tmp that is no longer needed is removed without touching the master checkout's ui/node_modules, and the way worktrees get their UI dependencies no longer leaves a junction that a recursive delete can follow.
acceptance: Every removal followed the order junction first, verify the master's ui/node_modules, then git worktree remove, and the master checkout's ui/node_modules is intact afterwards (its typescript binary present and `npx tsc --noEmit` clean in ui).
For each of the nine worktrees a note states its owner or that none could be established, what it held (branch, head, uncommitted changes), and whether it was removed or kept and why.

docs/test.md or the launcher says how a new worktree gets its UI dependencies, and if that is a junction, the launcher or a documented command creates and removes it, so that no agent makes one by hand.
